title: Canadian-based music star Elisha releases a new single titled "Step Up"
htmlContent:
Canadian-based music star Elisha is a multi-talented singer and songwriter who is just finding herself in the music industry as a fast-rising singer who does not disappoint in the release of her latest single, "Step Up."

Elisha's latest release, "Step Up," is a fantastic work that grabs the attention of anyone who can hear her song. Elisha is a hard-headed, confident, and an expressive young lady who is determined to make a name for herself in this harsh industry. She remains curious and open-minded as she explores her sound and finds herself musically.
